title: Experience Model v6: common-prefix CompilerGym writer pilot
summary: Replace the over-specified v6 assay with a smaller controlled branch beside Fable's exploratory organism. One base-model agent completes four acquisition tasks, then its condition-free public snapshot is cloned. HARNESS continues without an adapter; EXPERIENTIAL receives a rank-16 q/v LoRA trained only on verified immediate-improvement packet-to-action examples, continues four more tasks, and sleeps again cumulatively. Four fixed syntactic holdouts compare H, E_ON, and the same final E state with the adapter absent. The pilot reports only audited descriptive values and is designed to tell us whether direct verified action cloning is a useful lower bracket for later sleeper design.
system_thesis: This is an amortized component experiment, not the final thinker/sleeper. It isolates the smallest plausible experience-to-LoRA write while keeping the agent loop, public memory, action budget, task order, and fork state controlled. One common prefix eliminates fictitious cross-process parity requirements. The result can update the next sleep compiler: a positive E_ON versus E_OFF mount contrast motivates scaling; harm diagnoses write poisoning/interference; no effect says action cloning is too weak or the task/recipe lacks transferable structure.

nodes.before: v6 ran separate H and E prefixes and demanded impossible equality of identity-bearing GPU artifacts.
nodes.after: Run tasks 1--4 exactly once without an adapter; clone one condition-free public snapshot into H and E; train E sleep 1 while H remains unchanged; continue both through tasks 5--8.
nodes.rationale: Creates real identical starting state, removes redundant compute, and makes the first post-fork mount the only model-visible intervention.

nodes.before: v6 mixed scientifically useful packet/state rules with exhaustive actor and receipt closure.
nodes.after: One bounded canonical public packet yields one strict pass index per charged slot; exact audit encodings are frozen with implementation at T04 but never enter prompts or training.
nodes.rationale: Preserves reconstructibility while keeping the cognitive experiment small.

nodes.before: v6 required duplicate final builds and described tolerance agreement as determinism.
nodes.after: At tasks 4 and 8, cumulatively train one clean-base rank-16 q/v adapter on verified immediate-improvement packet-to-action rows; bind the realized build, without a duplicate-build claim.
nodes.rationale: Tests the writer rather than spending the pilot on a reproducibility sub-study.

nodes.before: v6 left missing-cell aggregation and the result-release metadata inconsistent.
nodes.after: Evaluate four fixed syntactic targets under H, E_ON, and same-state E_OFF; any missing cell suppresses both aggregate contrasts; every status and value is held until T05.
nodes.rationale: Eliminates result-dependent denominators and makes the final diagnostic interpretable.

nodes.before: v6 attempted OS-level default-deny closure for eleven logical actors and a risky 32B no-canary run.
nodes.after: Review the finite packet/training/target data paths, use a 7B GH200 budget, and start the one manifest with a synthetic maximum-length engineering canary before any gym action.
nodes.rationale: Protects compute and causal surfaces without converting a lower-bracket science pilot into a secure-systems project.

edges.before: Two nominally identical lives attempted to reproduce four tasks independently.
edges.after: One sealed public snapshot is copied byte-for-byte into H and E; condition and sleep identities remain offline-only.
edges.rationale: Guarantees equal public state at the intervention boundary.

edges.before: v6 admitted the same positive examples but burdened the edge with duplicate-build proof.
edges.after: Only exact packets for immediately improving common-prefix and E-life events become action-only SFT rows; sleep 1 uses prefix rows and sleep 2 uses their cumulative union with E rows.
edges.rationale: Provides the cleanest lower-bound write signal and excludes hidden outcome or thought targets.

edges.before: v6's target fork lifecycle included an oversized OS capability proof.
edges.after: Sealed H state, sealed E state, final E adapter, and the fixed target manifest generate twelve cold logical cells; receipts remain offline and cannot re-enter a model, life, or writer.
edges.rationale: Closes target feedback on the scientifically relevant data path.

loops.before: v6 used two full eight-task on-policy lives.
loops.after: A common four-task prefix forks into H and E, which each execute the same remaining four tasks; every task resets once and makes six reconstructed pass decisions with last-eight improving-event memory.
loops.trigger: Each acquisition program in fixed manifest order.
writes: condition-local public memory and task completion
loops.stop_condition: Six slots complete or the first run/integrity failure.
loops.rationale: Retains the requested two-agent comparison while making the fork exact and cheap.

loops.before: v6 rebuilt at two boundaries and duplicated the final build for a determinism claim.
loops.after: After the common prefix and after E task 8, select verified immediate improvements, build action-only masked samples, and rebuild one adapter from the clean base under a frozen recipe.
loops.trigger: Committed common task 4 and committed E task 8.
loops.stop_condition: Successful sealed mount or RUN_INCOMPLETE/INTEGRITY_FAILURE; no substitution or resume.
loops.rationale: Tests whether the simplest support-gated write changes future action policy.

loops.before: v6 did not freeze incomplete-panel aggregation.
loops.after: Run four fixed targets under H, E_ON, and E_OFF with six cold logical calls each; keep all results offline until postrun audit and suppress both aggregates if any cell is missing.
loops.trigger: Both acquisition continuations and E sleep 2 have sealed successfully.
reads: sealed H or E public snapshot
loops.stop_condition: Twelve complete cells, PANEL_INCOMPLETE, or INTEGRITY_FAILURE.
loops.rationale: Separates whole-life and same-state mount descriptions without target feedback.

claims.before: v6 allowed the name Experience Model v6 to sit beside a one-life action-cloning recipe.
claims.after: After T05 only, report whether the frozen pilot completed and its raw fixed-panel F, D_HE, and D_ONOFF values; interpret them only as guidance for the next sleep compiler.
claims.evidence_needed: Architecture and run ratifications, T01--T05, immutable common-prefix/fork/training/mount/target receipts, and the explicit syntactic-holdout limitation.

claims.before: Any claim of intelligent sleep, outcome learning, causal credit, semantic generalization, continual improvement, saturation, superiority, or paper readiness.
claims.after: Forbidden for this single controlled writer pilot.
claims.evidence_needed: A later preregistered replicated study with appropriate writer arms, semantic task structure, lives, and inferential analysis.

cells.reason: Synthetic packet fixtures and no-model environment state only.
The model receives only the current canonical public packet.
Each call receives its condition-local packet; the writer receives exact eligible E/common packets.
Each cell receives one target-local packet built from its sealed snapshot.
The reviewer recomputes packets and transitions from receipts.
Only synthetic writer and mount fixtures exist.
The common prefix has no condition label or adapter object.
The model receives adapter effects below the prompt; labels, rows, optimizer, and telemetry are not prompt-visible.
Only the assigned weights or NONE affect inference; condition labels and trainer state remain offline.
Rows, masks, updates, snapshot clones, adapter and mount hashes are audited.
Targets are sealed but no target result exists or enters the prefix.
No target result exists or enters either life or writer.

Only the postrun reviewer and reporter open all sealed cell receipts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independently authored CPU fixtures cover canonical packet bounds, strict action parsing, all accepted/rejected/malformed/no-op transitions, six-slot budgets, immediate-improvement memory append/eviction, exact common-prefix cloning, scores, and failure status.
acceptance_tests.expected: Fixture bytes and properties match the protocol; first post-fork H/E public packets are identical before applying the E mount.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the controlled public-state/action loop and fork are uniquely executable.

acceptance_tests.setup: CPU fixtures reconstruct event eligibility, hash validation, dedup/order, chat-template prefix/full token IDs, suffix-only labels, row/update counts, q/v inventory, optimizer ordering on toy tensors, and atomic publication failures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every selected row, mask, update count, target module, and failure branch matches independently frozen expectations; no forbidden data can become a target.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the minimal verified writer is uniquely and safely implemented.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exactly two fresh CPU no-model invocations enumerate unchanged local CompilerGym using the frozen seed/order/eligibility algorithm.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both emit byte-identical ordered 8/4 manifests; all twelve URIs and bitcode hashes are pairwise distinct within their modality; reset observations/I0/IOz repeat exactly; the report labels the panel syntactic only.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the environment can be selected reproducibly without model/Fable/target-result influence.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh history-free reviewer and non-overriding advocate inspect exact architecture, implementation, T01--T03, final manifest, finite packet/training/target paths, commands, and quantitative 7B GH200 memory/storage/time budget.
acceptance_tests.expected: The reviewer either approves the exact manifest or vetoes it; only approval permits presentation for the one human run ratification.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Closure and feasibility of the executable controlled pilot.

acceptance_tests.setup: After the single ratified run, a fresh history-free reviewer recomputes every actual packet/action/state/memory/row/update/mount/cell/score/status and verifies no target result re-entered a call or writer.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only a passing audit releases PILOT_COMPLETE, RUN_INCOMPLETE, PANEL_INCOMPLETE, INTEGRITY_FAILURE, raw cells, or aggregates; a mismatch suppresses all values.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That any reported pilot status or value is supported by the immutable actual run.

human_boundary.decision_question: Do you ratify these exact v7 architecture/protocol bytes as the separate controlled lower-bracket pilot, authorizing only isolated implementation, CPU fixtures, and exactly two no-model sealers? After T01--T04, one later exact 7B GH200 manifest will be presented once for the repository-required run ratification.
